Step tabs module

Source: R/modules.R
kit_step_tabs_ui.Rd

Two looks, one set of states (done ✓; not yet available gray plus the reason; run again removes the ✓):

Usage

kit_step_tabs_ui(id, ..., groups = NULL, selected = NULL, aside = NULL)

kit_step_tabs_server(id, states = NULL, tips = NULL)

Arguments

id

The module id.

...

shiny::tabPanel()s (value is required).

groups

Groups (a list of kit_navgroup()); NULL means an ordered flow.

selected

The tab selected at the start (value).

aside

Tabs in a flow that are not a step of the flow (value).

states

A reactive (or function): the state of each tab, a named character vector or list. Values are kit_status() states ("success" and "warning" add a ✓; "stale" removes the ✓), or directly "done", "locked", "ready". Tabs not listed are left unchanged. With NULL, no states are sent.

tips

The hover text for tabs not yet available: a named character vector (or a reactive that returns one), or one sentence for all.

Value

kit_step_tabs_ui(): the tab bar and the tabs.

kit_step_tabs_server(): a list,

  • selected: a reactive, the current tab (value);

  • select(value): switches to a tab;

  • states: a reactive, the states sent to the browser (the result of kit_tab_states()).

Details

  • Ordered flow (kitsUI): do not pass groups; the tabPanel() names in ... use circled numbers; aside tabs (for example "使用手冊", "User manual") are dashed and placed at the far right.

  • Grouped, unnumbered (kitJoin): pass groups (a list of kit_navgroup()); the tab bar is kit_navgroups(), and the real tabs are a hidden tabsetPanel().

The tabs' input is input[["<id>-tabs"]]; the selected() returned by the server is the same value.

See also

kit_flow_tabs(), kit_navgroups(), kit_tab_states() (low-level)

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  ui <- kit_page("KIT 示範", NULL,
    kit_step_tabs_ui("nav",
      shiny::tabPanel("① 資料", value = "data", "…"),
      shiny::tabPanel("② 題目校準", value = "items", "…")
    )
  )
  server <- function(input, output, session) {
    kit_step_tabs_server("nav",
      states = shiny::reactive(c(data = "success", items = "locked")),
      tips = c(items = "先在「① 資料」選好資料")
    )
  }
  shiny::shinyApp(ui, server)
}
